SELECT * FROM (WITH date_range AS 
      (SELECT d_month_seq 
      FROM date_dim 
      WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217+11), 
    store_sales_filtered AS 
        (SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_hdemo_sk, ss_addr_sk, ss_store_sk, SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price*ss_quantity,0)) sumsales 
        FROM store_sales JOIN date_range ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_month_seq 
                         JOIN item ON ss_item_sk=i_item_sk GROUP BY ss_item_sk, ss_hdemo_sk, ss_addr_sk, ss_store_sk), 
    dw1 AS 
        (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales 
        FROM store_sales_filtered JOIN date_dim ON ss_hdemo_sk=d_date_sk 
                                  JOIN store ON ss_store_sk=s_store_sk), 
    dw2 AS 
        (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, 
              RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) rk 
        FROM dw1), final AS (SELECT * FROM dw2 WHERE rk <= 100) 
 SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk 
 FROM final ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk LIMIT 100) AS _s 
ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk LIMIT 100
